name: lulu_print_api-mcp
description: Lulu Print API (ecommerce suppliers): me, create_order, get_order, track. Every tool maps to a docum

platform_mcp_lulu_print_api_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LULU_PRINT_API_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_lulu_print_api_client_id.description: Client key of your Lulu Print API account (developers.lulu.com > API Keys); sent with the secret as HTTP Basic on the client-credentials token request.

platform_mcp_lulu_print_api_client_secre.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LULU_PRINT_API_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_lulu_print_api_client_secre.description: Client secret from the same page. Sandbox keys belong to https://api.sandbox.lulu.com, which this server does not switch to.

platform_mcp_lulu_print_api_contact_emai.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LULU_PRINT_API_CONTACT_EMAIL
platform_mcp_lulu_print_api_contact_emai.description: contact_email sent with create_order (required by POST /print-jobs/): who Lulu contacts about the Print-Job.

platform_mcp_lulu_print_api_env.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LULU_PRINT_API_ENV
platform_mcp_lulu_print_api_env.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = https://api.sandbox.lulu.com. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

platform_mcp_lulu_print_api_base_url.title: PLATFORM_MCP_LULU_PRINT_API_BASE_URL
platform_mcp_lulu_print_api_base_url.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe mints a client-credentials token and reads GET /print-jobs/statistics/ (the number of Print-Jobs in each status).

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: POST /print-jobs/ creates a Print-Job (201). It 'will remain in an UNPAID state until it is paid for through the developer portal'; with a credit card on file it moves on automatically and 'your card will [be] charged when the Print-Job is sent to production' — so this can SPEND MONEY. `items` are line_items [{title, quantity, printable_normalization: {pod_package_id, cover: {source_url}, interior: {source_url}}} or {printable_id, quantity} for reorders]; `shipping_address` is {name, street1, street2, city, state_code, postcode, country_code, phone_number (required), email}; `shipping_option` is the shipping_level (MAIL, PRIORITY_MAIL, GROUND_HD, GROUND_BUS, GROUND, EXPEDITED, EXPRESS) and is required by Lulu. external_id is a fresh UUID. Costs are decimal strings (total_incl_tax).

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /print-jobs/{id}/: status.name is CREATED, REJECTED, UNPAID, PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS, PRODUCTION_READY, PRODUCTION_DELAYED, IN_PRODUCTION, ERROR, SHIPPED or CANCELED; costs {total_cost_incl_tax, currency, shipping_cost} are decimal strings; tracking_number is the first line item's status.messages.tracking_id once shipped.

tools.name: track
tools.description: GET /print-jobs/{id}/status/ — once shipped the status carries line_item_statuses [{name: SHIPPED, messages: {tracking_id, tracking_urls[], carrier_name}, line_item_id}] (one event per line item); before shipping the list is empty.
